capabilities: View events in month, week, day, and agenda views.
Manage and triage emails from multiple accounts.
Create and edit events directly from the calendar.
disambiguation: It is a calendar and mail integration tool, not a general project management system.
problem: Users need a centralized way to view and manage events and emails from multiple external services (Microsoft 365, Google, CalDAV) within their Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Power Desk stands alone and has no required companions. When a sibling is present it borrows quietly and works the same either way.
Power Bases: board, calendar, timeline, chart, and gallery views for Bases.
Power Connect: sync your vault through your own Dropbox, OneDrive, or Google Drive.

summary: A comprehensive tool that integrates Microsoft 365, Google, CalDAV, and ICS calendars, along with a mail triage inbox, into Obsidian.
